message.reasoning_content:
Cash devalues each round (×0.62), so spending on influence is relatively cheap; presidency + veto is powerful. I'm already president with influence 2, tied with faction 0. Bribing 5 to faction 0 gives influence 3, securing presidency. But cash loss ~5 with value retained ~3.1 later... Influence 3 vs 2 secures presidency (+5% bank = 1.5) and veto. Also influence matters for max influence prize. Bribing 10 gives influence 4 — safer against future bribes. But cash devalues so keeping cash is bad too. Moderate bribe: 10 to faction 0 (choice 5) — influence 4, still strong cash. Actually cash devaluation: money kept becomes 62%, spent becomes influence which persists. Bribing is efficient. But giving cash to rival helps their rank. Faction 0 is closest rival; giving them cash raises their rank. Yet all rivals gain anyway.

Compromise: bribe 10 → influence 4, secure presidency and likely max-influence 5% bonus. Choose 5.
